applies_why: The judge text decides a collision between the challenger's chain and the defender's chain and gives a reason about whether the challenger's chain names Joseph, so it is doing the chain-vs-chain thing K-C governs.
quote: the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: Phrase 'never verse by verse': one reading forbids using lack of explicit naming as a reason against a footed chain; the other allows it merely as a footing observation.
why: The judge calls the challenger's chain footed yet treats its not naming Joseph as begetter as a reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which is an explicit-wording/verse-level test rather than chain-vs-chain footing.
